summary: Heavy foreign buying, softer crude, a firmer rupee and a Friday tech rebound on Wall Street support the next session, but a near-9% weekly surge leaves the market stretched.

detail.leaders: Private banks and large caps, which drew record foreign buying last week
detail.laggards: Mid and small caps, which lagged the rally; stretched gains invite profit-taking
detail.tone: First weekend read: it follows Friday's seventh straight gain and the best week since February 2021. The next session is Sunday's one-hour Diwali Muhurat trade, then Monday Nov 9; markets shut Tuesday Nov 10.
watch: Whether foreign buying continues in the Muhurat session and on Monday
